title: Lisa Brennan-Jobs reveals more details from her memoir about life with her father Steve Jobs - and it sounds absolutely brutal (AAPL)
text: Lisa Brennan-Jobs reveals more details from her memoir about life with her father Steve Jobs — and it sounds absolutely brutal (AAPL) By Rob Price Aug 23, 2018, 2:57 pm 10 pts A new memoir written by Steve Jobs' daughter Lisa Brennan-Jobs, "Small Fry," provides a brutal window into the Apple cofounder's relationship with his child. He could be cruel, and was at times inappropriate in front of her, she writes. In one incident from the book, Brennan-Jobs' mother asked him…
